title: We started making this game the week our son was born. Now he's nearly 2, has a little sister, and the demo is in Steam Next Fest! | Mithril
author: gelflit
selftext:
Hi! We’re Connor & Tiffany, a two-person family studio in Melbourne, and this is Mithril. It’s a cave mining survival game with advanced cave collapsing physics, thermodynamics, and automation.

We started building Mithril a few days after we got home from the hospital after the birth of our first child. Connor has been an avid gamer and game designer since he was a kid and decided it was time to pursue it more seriously to set an example for our son that he can chase his dreams.

Fast forward to now, the demo is a part of Next Fest and people from all over the world are playing something we built while sleep deprived and nursing tiny humans, in between naps and tantrums and all of the ups and downs of parenthood. We couldn’t be more proud, if only for the fact that one day our kids will be old enough to play a game that their mum and dad built.

Full disclosure, I know that AI, sometimes rightfully, gets a lot of criticism as it should. But the fact that it’s unlocked a way for us to create something we’ve dreamed of for years feels a little magical.

When there’s true love and effort put into it, does the fact that it uses AI still make it slop? We like to think people can see the difference

comments.author: Silver-Second-647
comments.body:
First of all, what a wonderful story! ❤️

https://reddit.com/link/pi006fx/video/xfs7nfwwvswh1/player

And Mithril looks really cool! I especially like the cave environments and the destruction effects.

I'm an indie developer myself, and I couldn't resist experimenting with a few moments from your trailer from a sound design perspective.

A lot of the atmosphere is already there, but I thought some of the cave destruction and environmental interactions could feel even more impactful with a slightly different sound treatment.

So I put together a little alternate sound design version while keeping the parts I liked!

Hope you don't mind me sharing it here. Would love to hear what you think! 🔊

And congratulations on making it to Steam Next Fest! 🎉

replies.author: gelflit
replies.body:
Thank you so much!!

That's so cool, those sound effects came out really nicely! Thank you for sharing! You've got me inspired, maybe we need to have real in-game sounds play as well as the music for future trailers 😄 keep up the good work! ❤️

replies.author: Silver-Second-647
replies.body:
Aww, I'm so happy you liked it!! ❤️

I think mixing some in-game sound effects with the music could make your future trailers feel even more immersive, especially with those awesome cave destruction effects! 😄

If you'd ever like to use any of the sounds I made, feel free to DM me! I'd be happy to share the audio files with you.

Wishing you and your family all the best with Mithril! 🎮✨

replies.author: gelflit
replies.body: That's so kind! Thank you so much, we really appreciate it! ❤️
